data.description: Learn more about the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2), an open protocol that builds on A2A, Agent to Agent Protocol. AP2 was developed by Google with leading payments and technology companies to securely initiate and transact agent-led payments across platforms.

<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">We’re collaborating with a diverse group of more than 60 organizations to help shape the future of agentic payments, including Adyen, American Express, Ant International, Coinbase, Etsy, Forter, Intuit, JCB, Mastercard, Mysten Labs, Paypal, Revolut, Salesforce, ServiceNow, UnionPay International, Worldpay, and more. </span></p></div></section><section class="YNV64d"><section><div jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md" jscontroller="wJu6E" class="nRhiJb-aTv5jf glue-video__preview-container glue-video__preview-container--inline" data-video-url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yLTp3ic2j5c" tabindex="0" role="button"><div class="glue-video__preview-container p7j5vb vgZZI glue-video__preview-container--inline"><picture class="nRhiJb-zTg1Jd"><section class="PBkdHd "><img class=" glue-video__preview-image" src="https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/images/image1_YoRSHai.max-1600x1600.png" alt="https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/images/image1_YoRSHai.max-1600x1600.png" loading="lazy"></section></picture><div class="nRhiJb-hEKMR"><svg class="nRhiJb-Bz112c nRhiJb-euxe5d-LgbsSe" viewBox="0 0 24 24" role="presentation" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="#f00" d="M23.74 7.1s-.23-1.65-.95-2.37c-.91-.96-1.93-.96-2.4-1.02C17.04 3.47 12 3.5 12 3.5s-5.02-.03-8.37.21c-.46.06-1.48.06-2.39 1.02C.52 5.45.28 7.1.28 7.1S.04 9.05 0 10.98V13c.04 1.94.28 3.87.28 3.87s.24 1.65.96 2.38c.91.95 2.1.92 2.64 1.02 1.88.18 7.91.22 8.12.22 0 0 5.05.01 8.4-.23.46-.06 1.48-.06 2.39-1.02.72-.72.96-2.37.96-2.37s.24-1.94.25-3.87v-2.02c-.02-1.93-.26-3.88-.26-3.88zM9.57 15.5V8.49L16 12.13 9.57 15.5z"></path><polygon fill="#fff" points="9.6,15.5 9.6,8.5 16,12.1 "></polygon></svg></div></div><div class="glue-video__container nRhiJb-LilHSb-OWXEXe-TzA9Ye vgZZI glue-video--hidden" data-glue-yt-video-height="100%" data-glue-yt-video-width="100%" tabindex="0" id="youtube-player-891660"><iframe frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" title="Intro to Google Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)" width="100%" height="100%" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/yLTp3ic2j5c?origin=https%3A%2F%2Fcloud.google.com&enablejsapi=1&widgetid=1&forigin=https%3A%2F%2Fcloud.google.com%2Fblog%2Fproducts%2Fai-machine-learning%2Fannouncing-agents-to-payments-ap2-protocol&aoriginsup=1&vf=1" id="widget2"></iframe></div></div></section></section><section class="Wy08Ac nRhiJb-qJTHM-OWXEXe-hJDwNd nRhiJb-DbgRPb-II5mzb-cGMI2b"><div jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md" jscontroller="M0Q3Qb" data-is-cws-richtext="true" class=" "><h3 class="MnozTc-Bz112c MnozTc-Bz112c-OWXEXe-R6PoUb"><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Why is a protocol needed?</strong></h3>
<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">AI agents are capable of transacting on behalf of users, which creates a need to establish a common foundation to securely authenticate, validate, and convey an agent’s authority to transact. While </span><span style="vertical-align:baseline">today’s payment systems generally assume a human is directly clicking "buy" on a trusted surface, the rise of autonomous agents and their ability to initiate a payment breaks this fundamental assumption and raises critical questions that AP2 helps to address, including:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline">
<p><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Authorization</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline">: Proving that a user gave an agent the specific authority to make a particular purchase.</span></p>
</li>
<li style="list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline">
<p><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Authenticity</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline">: Enabling a merchant to be sure that an agent's request accurately reflects the user's true intent. </span></p>
</li>
<li style="list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline">
<p><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Accountability</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline">: Determining accountability if a fraudulent or incorrect transaction occurs. </span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">AP2 is an open, shared protocol that provides a common language for secure, compliant transactions between agents and merchants, helping to prevent a fragmented ecosystem. It also supports different payment types–from credit and debit cards to stablecoins and real-time bank transfers. This helps ensure a consistent, secure, and scalable experience for users and merchants, while also providing financial institutions with the clarity they need to effectively manage risk.</span></p>
<h3 class="MnozTc-Bz112c MnozTc-Bz112c-OWXEXe-ibL1re"><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">How it works: Establishing trust via mandates and verifiable credentials</strong></h3>
<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">AP2 builds trust by using Mandates—tamper-proof, cryptographically-signed digital contracts that serve as verifiable proof of a user's instructions. These mandates are signed by verifiable credentials (VCs) and act as the foundational evidence for every transaction.</span></p>
<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">Mandates address the two primary ways a user will shop with an agent:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline">
<p><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Real-time purchases (human present</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline">): When you ask an agent, “Find me new white running shoes,” your request is captured in an initial </span><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Intent Mandate</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline">. This provides the auditable context for the entire interaction in a transaction process. After the agent presents a cart with the shoes you want, your approval signs a </span><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Cart Mandate</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline">. This is a critical step that creates a secure, unchangeable record of the exact items and price, ensuring what you see is what you pay for.</span></p>
</li>
<li style="list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline">
<p><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Delegated tasks (human not present)</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline">: When you delegate a task like, “Buy concert tickets the moment they go on sale,” you sign a detailed </span><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Intent Mandate</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline"> upfront. This mandate specifies the rules of engagement—price limits, timing, and other conditions. It serves as verifiable, pre-authorized proof that can allow the agent to automatically generate a </span><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Cart Mandate</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline"> on your behalf once your precise conditions are met.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">In both scenarios, this chain of evidence culminates in securely linking your payment method to the verified contents of the Cart Mandate. This complete sequence—from intent, to cart, to payment—creates a non-repudiable audit trail that answers the critical questions of authorization and authenticity, providing a clear foundation for accountability.</span></p>
<h3 class="MnozTc-Bz112c MnozTc-Bz112c-OWXEXe-c5RTEf"><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Unlocking new commerce experiences</strong></h3>
<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">AP2’s flexible design provides a foundation to support both simple and entirely new commercial models. Let’s consider a few examples below, which all assume Intent Mandates have been signed on behalf of a user: </span></p>
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline">
<p><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Smarter shopping</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline">: A customer discovers a winter jacket they want is unavailable in a specific color, so they tell their agent: "I really want this jacket in green, and I'm willing to pay up to 20% more for it." The agent then monitors prices and availability and automatically executes a secure purchase the moment that specific variant is found, capturing a high-intent sale that would have otherwise been lost.</span></p>
</li>
<li style="list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline">
<p><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Personalized offers</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline">: A shopper tells their agent they want a new bicycle for an upcoming trip from a specific merchant. Their agent communicates this information—which includes the trip's date—to the merchant, whose own agent can respond by creating a custom, time-sensitive bundle offer that includes the bike, a helmet, and a travel rack at a 15% discount, turning a simple query into a more valuable sale.</span></p>
</li>
<li style="list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline">
<p><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Coordinated tasks</strong><span style="vertical-align:baseline">: A user is planning a weekend trip and tells their agent: "Book me a round-trip flight and a hotel in Palm Springs for the first weekend of November, with a total budget of $700." The agent can then interact with both airline and hotel agents, as well as online travel agencies and booking platforms, and once it finds a combination that fits the budget, it can execute both cryptographically-signed bookings simultaneously.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="MnozTc-Bz112c MnozTc-Bz112c-OWXEXe-II5mzb"><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Support for emerging payments systems</strong></h3>
<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">AP2 is designed as a universal protocol, providing security and trust for a variety of payments like stablecoins and cryptocurrencies. To accelerate support for the web3 ecosystem, in collaboration with Coinbase, Ethereum Foundation, MetaMask and other leading organizations, we have extended the core constructs of AP2 and launched the </span><a href="https://github.com/google-a2a/a2a-x402" rel="noopener" target="_blank" track-name="a2a x402 extension" track-type="inline link" track-metadata-eventdetail="github.com/google-a2a/a2a-x402"><span style="text-decoration:underline;vertical-align:baseline">A2A x402 extension</span></a><span style="vertical-align:baseline">, a production-ready solution for agent-based crypto payments. Extensions like these will help shape the evolution of cryptocurrency integrations within the core AP2 protocol. </span></p>
<h3 class="MnozTc-Bz112c MnozTc-Bz112c-OWXEXe-R6PoUb"><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">What’s next: A call for collaboration </strong></h3>
<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">AP2 provides a trusted foundation to fuel a new era of AI-driven commerce. It establishes the core building blocks for secure transactions, creating clear opportunities for the industry–including networks, issuers, merchants, technology providers, and end users–to innovate on adjacent areas like seamless agent authorization and decentralized identity. We are committed to evolving this protocol in an open, collaborative process, including through standards bodies, and  invite the entire payments and technology community to build this future with us. </span></p>
<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">Many of the partners building A2A agents have extended their support to AP2. This growing ecosystem will continue to make their agents available in our AI Agent Marketplace, including new, transactable experiences enabled by AP2. For example, enterprise companies could use AP2 for B2B applications, such as enabling autonomous procurement of partner-built solutions via Google Cloud Marketplace or the automatic scaling of software licenses based upon real-time needs.</span></p>
<p><span style="vertical-align:baseline">To get started, visit our public </span><a href="http://goo.gle/ap2" rel="opener" target="_blank" track-name="github repository" track-type="inline link" track-metadata-eventdetail="goo.gle/ap2"><span style="text-decoration:underline;vertical-align:baseline">GitHub repository</span></a><span style="vertical-align:baseline"> to review the complete technical specification, documentation, and reference implementations. Moving forward, this repository will be updated regularly with additional reference implementations from Google and innovations from the community to demonstrate the power and scalability of AP2.</span></p></div></section><section class="QzPuud"><div><section><figure class="NEBdNd"><section class="PBkdHd DhGbH" jscontroller="SCGBie" jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md"><img class="JcsBte mZzdH ZOnyjc" src="https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/original_images/AP2_Partners.jpg" alt="https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/original_images/AP2_Partners.jpg" jsname="P3Vluc" jsaction="click:HTIlC" loading="lazy"><section class="glue-modal glue-modal--dark QHdDac" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"><img class="JcsBte mZzdH ZOnyjc" src="https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/original_images/AP2_Partners.jpg" alt="https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/original_images/AP2_Partners.jpg" jsname="P3Vluc" jsaction="click:HTIlC" loading="lazy"><button class="glue-modal__close-btn" tabindex="0" aria-label="Close this modal"></button></section></section></figure></section></div></section><section class="Wy08Ac nRhiJb-qJTHM-OWXEXe-hJDwNd nRhiJb-DbgRPb-II5mzb-cGMI2b"><div jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md" jscontroller="M0Q3Qb" data-is-cws-richtext="true" class=" "><p><strong style="vertical-align:baseline">Support from our ecosystem</strong></p>

The protocol can be used as an extension of the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href\u003d\"https://a2a-protocol.org\" rel\u003d\"noopener\" target\u003d\"_blank\"\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"text-decoration:underline;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAgent2Agent (A2A) protocol\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e and Model Context Protocol (MCP). In concert with industry rules and standards, it establishes a payment-agnostic framework for users, merchants, and payments providers to transact with confidence across all types of payment methods.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eWe’re collaborating with a diverse group of more than 60 organizations to help shape the future of agentic payments, including Adyen, American Express, Ant International, Coinbase, Etsy, Forter, Intuit, JCB, Mastercard, Mysten Labs, Paypal, Revolut, Salesforce, ServiceNow, UnionPay International, Worldpay, and more. \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"]]],[null,null,null,null,null,null,["https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\u003dyLTp3ic2j5c",[null,""],null,["https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/images/image1_YoRSHai.max-1600x1600.png","https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/images/image1_YoRSHai.max-1100x1100.png 1060w, https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/images/image1_YoRSHai.max-1600x1600.png 1557w"," 1060px,  1557px","https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/images/image1_YoRSHai.max-1600x1600.png"]]],[null,null,[null,[null,"\u003ch3\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eWhy is a protocol needed?\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAI agents are capable of transacting on behalf of users, which creates a need to establish a common foundation to securely authenticate, validate, and convey an agent’s authority to transact. While \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003etoday’s payment systems generally assume a human is directly clicking \"buy\" on a trusted surface, the rise of autonomous agents and their ability to initiate a payment breaks this fundamental assumption and raises critical questions that AP2 helps to address, including:\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\u003cli style\u003d\"list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAuthorization\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e: Proving that a user gave an agent the specific authority to make a particular purchase.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli style\u003d\"list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAuthenticity\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e: Enabling a merchant to be sure that an agent's request accurately reflects the user's true intent. \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli style\u003d\"list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAccountability\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e: Determining accountability if a fraudulent or incorrect transaction occurs. \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAP2 is an open, shared protocol that provides a common language for secure, compliant transactions between agents and merchants, helping to prevent a fragmented ecosystem. It also supports different payment types–from credit and debit cards to stablecoins and real-time bank transfers. This helps ensure a consistent, secure, and scalable experience for users and merchants, while also providing financial institutions with the clarity they need to effectively manage risk.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eHow it works: Establishing trust via mandates and verifiable credentials\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAP2 builds trust by using Mandates—tamper-proof, cryptographically-signed digital contracts that serve as verifiable proof of a user's instructions. These mandates are signed by verifiable credentials (VCs) and act as the foundational evidence for every transaction.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eMandates address the two primary ways a user will shop with an agent:\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\u003cli style\u003d\"list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eReal-time purchases (human present\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e): When you ask an agent, “Find me new white running shoes,” your request is captured in an initial \u003c/span\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eIntent Mandate\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e. This provides the auditable context for the entire interaction in a transaction process. After the agent presents a cart with the shoes you want, your approval signs a \u003c/span\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eCart Mandate\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e. This is a critical step that creates a secure, unchangeable record of the exact items and price, ensuring what you see is what you pay for.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli style\u003d\"list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eDelegated tasks (human not present)\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e: When you delegate a task like, “Buy concert tickets the moment they go on sale,” you sign a detailed \u003c/span\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eIntent Mandate\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e upfront. This mandate specifies the rules of engagement—price limits, timing, and other conditions. It serves as verifiable, pre-authorized proof that can allow the agent to automatically generate a \u003c/span\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eCart Mandate\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e on your behalf once your precise conditions are met.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eIn both scenarios, this chain of evidence culminates in securely linking your payment method to the verified contents of the Cart Mandate. This complete sequence—from intent, to cart, to payment—creates a non-repudiable audit trail that answers the critical questions of authorization and authenticity, providing a clear foundation for accountability.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eUnlocking new commerce experiences\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAP2’s flexible design provides a foundation to support both simple and entirely new commercial models. Let’s consider a few examples below, which all assume Intent Mandates have been signed on behalf of a user: \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\u003cli style\u003d\"list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eSmarter shopping\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e: A customer discovers a winter jacket they want is unavailable in a specific color, so they tell their agent: \"I really want this jacket in green, and I'm willing to pay up to 20% more for it.\" The agent then monitors prices and availability and automatically executes a secure purchase the moment that specific variant is found, capturing a high-intent sale that would have otherwise been lost.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli style\u003d\"list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003ePersonalized offers\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e: A shopper tells their agent they want a new bicycle for an upcoming trip from a specific merchant. Their agent communicates this information—which includes the trip's date—to the merchant, whose own agent can respond by creating a custom, time-sensitive bundle offer that includes the bike, a helmet, and a travel rack at a 15% discount, turning a simple query into a more valuable sale.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli style\u003d\"list-style-type:disc;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eCoordinated tasks\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e: A user is planning a weekend trip and tells their agent: \"Book me a round-trip flight and a hotel in Palm Springs for the first weekend of November, with a total budget of $700.\" The agent can then interact with both airline and hotel agents, as well as online travel agencies and booking platforms, and once it finds a combination that fits the budget, it can execute both cryptographically-signed bookings simultaneously.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003ch3\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eSupport for emerging payments systems\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAP2 is designed as a universal protocol, providing security and trust for a variety of payments like stablecoins and cryptocurrencies. To accelerate support for the web3 ecosystem, in collaboration with Coinbase, Ethereum Foundation, MetaMask and other leading organizations, we have extended the core constructs of AP2 and launched the \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href\u003d\"https://github.com/google-a2a/a2a-x402\" rel\u003d\"noopener\" target\u003d\"_blank\"\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"text-decoration:underline;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eA2A x402 extension\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e, a production-ready solution for agent-based crypto payments. Extensions like these will help shape the evolution of cryptocurrency integrations within the core AP2 protocol. \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eWhat’s next: A call for collaboration \u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAP2 provides a trusted foundation to fuel a new era of AI-driven commerce. It establishes the core building blocks for secure transactions, creating clear opportunities for the industry–including networks, issuers, merchants, technology providers, and end users–to innovate on adjacent areas like seamless agent authorization and decentralized identity. We are committed to evolving this protocol in an open, collaborative process, including through standards bodies, and  invite the entire payments and technology community to build this future with us. \u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eMany of the partners building A2A agents have extended their support to AP2. This growing ecosystem will continue to make their agents available in our AI Agent Marketplace, including new, transactable experiences enabled by AP2. For example, enterprise companies could use AP2 for B2B applications, such as enabling autonomous procurement of partner-built solutions via Google Cloud Marketplace or the automatic scaling of software licenses based upon real-time needs.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eTo get started, visit our public \u003c/span\u003e\u003ca href\u003d\"http://goo.gle/ap2\" rel\u003d\"noopener\" target\u003d\"_blank\"\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"text-decoration:underline;vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eGitHub repository\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e to review the complete technical specification, documentation, and reference implementations. Moving forward, this repository will be updated regularly with additional reference implementations from Google and innovations from the community to demonstrate the power and scalability of AP2.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/p\u003e"]]],[null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,[[[null,""],["https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/original_images/AP2_Partners.jpg","https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/original_images/AP2_Partners.jpg 1060w, https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/original_images/AP2_Partners.jpg 2120w"," 1060px,  2120px","https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-cloudblog-publish/original_images/AP2_Partners.jpg"],null,3]]],[null,null,[null,[null,"\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eSupport from our ecosystem\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAccenture: \u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e“Google Cloud's Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) complements the Agent2Agent protocol and Model Context Protocol to provide a unified framework for agents to transact. Innovations like this will enable many of the agentic solutions that reinvent payments for clients – not only for today’s needs, but for the evolving models of future commerce.” – \u003c/span\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eScott Alfieri, Google Business lead at Accenture\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAdobe:\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e “Adobe is proud to work with Google to advance secure and authenticated agentic commerce - our role in the \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAgent Payments Protocol\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e (AP2) underscores our commitment to trusted, AI-driven experiences. With Adobe Commerce and AI agents powering customer journeys, we are focused on delivering secure, reliable, and authentic transactions for businesses and consumers.\"  -\u003c/span\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e Loni Stark, VP of Strategy and Product at Adobe\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAdyen:\u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e \"Agentic commerce is not just about a consumer-facing chatbot, but about the underlying infrastructure that powers it all. Adyen’s collaboration on Google’s Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) is a natural extension of our mission to provide the merchants with the payments building blocks for tomorrow’s commerce. We're excited to help establish a common rulebook that ensures security and interoperability for everyone involved in the payments ecosystem.\" - \u003c/span\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eIngo Uytdehaage, Co-CEO at Adyen\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAirwallex: \u003c/strong\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e\"Airwallex is thrilled to support Google’s \u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003eAgent Payments Protocol (AP2)\u003c/span\u003e\u003cspan style\u003d\"vertical-align:baseline\"\u003e. This is a critical step forward in building a secure, interoperable ecosystem for agentic AI payments.
